floor_rationale: Frozen on 2026-11-06 before any main-seed run. Pilot seeds 9001-9002 (20k and 40k exposure bytes) gave held-out improvements over byte-frequency of ~1.7-1.8 BPB (delta) and ~0.85 BPB (hebbian); the floor is set well below both so it tests acquisition, not tuning luck. Constants were chosen on pilot seeds only.
